articles.title: White-collar job losses loom as AI advances
articles.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warns AI could eliminate up to 50% of entry-level white-collar jobs, potentially raising unemployment to 10–20% in the next five years.

articles.title: AI robots face real-world deployment challenges
articles.summary: Advancements in AI robotics are hindered by safety and training issues, limiting their real-world deployment despite technological progress.

articles.title: California bar exam's AI scandal prompts retake
articles.summary: The California State Bar faces scrutiny after using AI to draft exam questions, leading to technical issues and a high-stakes retake.

articles.title: Meta restructures AI team to compete with OpenAI
articles.summary: Meta is reorganizing its AI teams to accelerate development and deployment of new AI products amid rising competition.

articles.title: Microsoft Build 2025 highlights AI integration
articles.summary: At Microsoft Build 2025, the company emphasized AI integration across platforms, introducing new features and partnerships.

articles.title: Autonomous agents to dominate AI agenda in 2025
articles.summary: Executives forecast that autonomous agents and profitability will be central to the AI agenda in 2025, with advancements in step-by-step reasoning.

articles.title: World leaders to discuss AI at Paris summit
articles.summary: Representatives from 80 countries, including world leaders and tech executives, will gather in Paris to discuss AI progress and future goals.
